_comment: Maintainer-decision dispositions for the standing candidate queue: pixelfx, ernd, DS-Bot, nxnative, Cloudflare Clairic, CalendarHero, Smithery, and the StaysPrivate submission. Underlying scan and triage records remain unchanged; approved bring-ups run the standard scoped engine run in their own PR. No score or rank is set here.

dispositions.name: pixelfx
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: popularity unverifiable, suspected inorganic star velocity; manual maintainer recheck required when popularity can be verified. Not ranked; retained as an agent-skills candidate in open-rankings/arena-roadmap.json. Roadmap membership does not schedule another scan; a maintainer must recheck the popularity evidence and record a new dated disposition before any approved bring-up.
evidence: reports/vendor-radar/runs/2026-11-04-41800458778-1-triage.json — star velocity ~857/day exceeds the 500/day anomaly floor; popularity unverifiable keylessly.
reports/2026-11-05-candidate-queue-followup.md — relevant agent skill and documentation confirmed; the popularity exception routed the call to a maintainer.

dispositions.name: ernd
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: add to expense-management. Verified live 2026-11-09: a corporate credit card for US companies (4% back on AI vendor spend, 1.5% elsewhere) with a maintained llms.txt, markdown page mirrors, and machine-readable rates/limits JSON as the agentic surface. On-axis for the corporate-card side of the expense-management definition. The earlier card-issuing skip stands: no developer-first issuing or authorization API is documented. Bring-up runs the standard scoped engine run in its own PR.
evidence: https://ernd.ai/llms.txt — fetched 2026-11-09; documents the card product, llms-full.txt, rates.json, ai-api-rate-limits, inference-prices; discloses paid partner listings.
reports/2026-11-05-candidate-queue-followup.md — card-issuing nomination skipped for lack of issuing-API evidence; that skip is unchanged.

dispositions.name: DS-Bot
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: skip. A low-evidence product: the only public surface is a young repository whose ~216 stars/day velocity tripped the popularity floor, with no citable product site, docs surface, or agentic surface beyond the README. The candidate record is closed; a future scan can renominate on new evidence.
evidence: reports/vendor-radar/2026-10-26-triage.json — needs-human row: repo created 2026-10-07, stars=4039, ~216 stars/day, contributors=4.

dispositions.name: Cloudflare Clairic → speech-to-text
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: skip the speech-to-text placement. The launch introduces an extraction-model class; the source does not document a speech-to-text API with file/URL ingestion, async jobs, diarization, or timestamps.
evidence: reports/launch-watch/2026-10-26-triage.json — needs-human row with the launch headline and the 2-keyword lexical match (model, models) below the arena definition's requirements.

dispositions.name: CalendarHero
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: the PR #629 skip stands. calendarhero.com is live but names no public API, MCP server, agent docs, or llms.txt; the former developer-docs host does not resolve. The vendor-import-queue row is annotated closed.
evidence: PR #629 body (merged) — calendarhero.com fetched 2026-11-05 (HTTP 200) with no agentic surface; calendarhero.com/llms.txt → 404; developers.calendarhero.com unresolvable.
docs/vendor-import-queue.json — queue row disposition updated to skipped with the PR #629 pointer.

dispositions.name: Smithery
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: retained post-shutdown; radar monitors. The AGPL CLI remains live under the acquirer's organization and the recorded probes stand. Smithery publishes as judged at 6.8 (8 of 8 in mcp-infrastructure); negative results stay published.
evidence: open-rankings/mcp-infrastructure/proofs/smithery/ — recorded keyless registry search, MCP handshakes, and npm CLI install/version proofs.

dispositions.name: StaysPrivate
dispositions.reason: Held for maintainer decision: a disclosed vendor self-submission. The 2026-11-05 follow-up verified the supplied llms.txt, tool instructions, and MIT library README; browser-local conversion scope and the absence of an API or CLI are recorded there. Issue #607 stays open until the maintainer decides.
evidence: reports/2026-11-05-candidate-queue-followup.md — manual verification receipts and the bring-up considerations.
https://staysprivate.com/llms.txt — supplied in the submission; verified in the 2026-11-05 review.
